description: Sixteen knobs sent out as one polyphonic cable, with a scale knob and an offset knob acting on every channel.

params.text: Sets the voltage of that channel of the output, 0-10V, or -10V to +10V when the menu sets the knobs bipolar.
Sets how many channels the output carries, 1 to 16.
Multiplies every channel knob before the offset is added, -2 to +2.
Adds a fixed voltage to every channel after the scale knob, -10V to +10V.

outputs.text: Carries one channel per knob, each knob voltage multiplied by the scale knob and then offset.

menu: Main Knob Range — Unipolar sets the sixteen channel knobs to 0-10V and Bipolar sets them to -10V to +10V.
